'''Efridge Engelhardt Efridge's WYS Kessel Runs v 2 0''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Efridge Engelhardt]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-18464">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18464 Efridge's WYS Kessel Runs v  2 0], DeckTech (Efridge "Efridge" Engelhardt, 19 August 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18464/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18464/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
